title: Raanjhnaa
desc: Kundan has loved Zoya since childhood, but he learns she loves another. When he discovers she lied about her fiance's religion, his heartbreak turns into uncontrollable rage and obsession.

title: Raazi
desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Prem Rog
desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: Kuch Kuch Locha Hai
desc: Praveen Patel, a 45-year-old businessman, loves his religious wife but feels bored. His life changes when a young actress wants to live with him to prepare for a role.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.

title: Bombay To Goa
desc: Mala, a young woman who witnesses a murder, flees on a Goa-bound bus. Along the way, she meets colourful travellers from different cultures and a spirited young man who refuses to leave her side.

title: Race
desc: Ranvir and Rajiv were always close as brothers, but fierce ambition, deep dark secrets, and a dangerous game of love quickly turn them into bitter mortal enemies.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Nagina (1986)
desc: Rajiv, saved as a child from a snake bite, later marries Rajni. Bhaironath claims she is a snake seeking revenge for her lover, but actually wants her hidden pearl.
